name: 2.9.5 - Update button
notes: Update button: Update now on the RDP helper and the desk receiver asks GitHub at once (past its caches) and, if there's a newer version, installs it and restarts into it by itself: no closing and opening. Includes 2.9.4 (Repair Orders open on another PC; the page's orders not paused by a moment of COSTAR's) and 2.9.3. Update the RDP helper and the desk PC.
